title: Polymorph+
description: (26.1.2 port) No more recipe conflicts! Adds an option to choose the crafting result if more than one is available.
body:
[![Wabbanode](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/101574d2252d501a181cc771473884e9d4b81a63.png)](https://wabbanode.com/affiliate/amine)

Polymorph+

Polymorph+ resolves recipe conflicts by letting the player pick which output a given set of ingredients should produce. Conflicting recipes stay co-installed, you choose the result. > MC 26+ builds are beta (NeoForge and Fabric 26.x are themselves still in beta), back up your worlds before loading. 1.21.11 is stable. ## Features ### Crafting table A button appears above the output slot when ingredients match more than one recipe. Click it, pick the result. The selection persists as long as the input stays the same. ### Smelting (furnace, blast furnace, smoker) Same selector above the output slot. The choice is saved on the block. ### Smithing When a smithing transform input matches more than one recipe, the selector appears next to the result slot. ### Crafters Same selector inside the vanilla Crafter screen. The choice is saved on the block entity so redstone automation respects it across world reloads. ### Quality of life - Scrollable selector when there are more than seven conflicts (mouse wheel or side arrows). - Pinned panel. Right click the open arrow to dock the selector for the session, left click to unpin. Pin state is saved to `config/polymorph_plus_client.json`. - First-run tutorial. Four hint bubbles, English and French, auto-dismiss after eight seconds. - JEI and REI compatibility (WIP). The "+" fill button (JEI) and auto-craft button (REI) currently keep the previous selection on click. Manual pick via the polymorph selector works fine. ### Commands `/polymorph conflicts` scans crafting, smelting, blasting, smoking, and smithing recipes and writes a list of detected conflicts to the logs folder. ## Credits and license Original mod by [TheIllusiveC4](https://www.curseforge.com/members/theillusivec4), [upstream repo](https://github.com/illusivesoulworks/polymorph). Port maintained by [Aminoquiz](https://github.com/Aminoquiz). Source and assets are LGPL-3.0-or-later.
